channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock expands API support and introduces Cross Region Inferencing for OpenAI models
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports the OpenAI GPT-5.6 models (Sol, Terra, and Luna) on the bedrock-runtime endpoint, with support for the Responses, Converse, and Chat Completions APIs. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon ECR now supports 25 replication rules per registry
item.description: Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) has increased the maximum number of replication rules per registry from 10 to 25. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling now supports batch instance termination
item.description: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling now supports batch instance termination in a single API call. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon MSK now supports configuring custom domain names for MSK Provisioned clusters
item.description: You can now easily configure custom domain names on Amazon MSK Provisioned clusters, on either ZooKeeper or KRaft mode for metadata management. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 R8i and R8i-Flex instances are now available in Canada West (Calgary) region
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) R8i and R8i-flex instances are available in the Canada West (Calgary) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer dashboards now support reporting on routing steps and agent proficiencies
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer dashboards now support reporting on routing steps and agent proficiencies enabling supervisors to monitor and optimize how contacts are matched to agents based on agent proficiencies. (1 source: aws)
